messages:
maria: pushing the 2026.03.1 tag to staging failed during promote, throwing artifact checksum mismatch. anyone else seeing this?

deploy-bot: promote request received for image:redwood/serve:2026.03.1 -> staging
deploy-bot: ERROR: artifact checksum mismatch for s3://releases/serve/2026.03.1/serve.tar.gz expected=3f2a1b got=9c8d7e (code: ARTIFACT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH) :warning:

kevin: ack, I see the same in the deploy logs. build pipeline uploaded two artifacts with different digests.

ana: (typo) ana: checking the CI upload step now, looks like parallel upload workers retried and one overwrote a partial file.

oncall-sre: any impact on prod?

maria: staging only so far, prod unchanged. we have a canary scheduled for tonight in the change window though.

jen: proposed options: 1) roll back the promote and re-run release pipeline after a clean build; 2) manually re-upload the correct artifact and mark it immutable; 3) pin the canary to previous tag (2026.02.4) and delay promote. thoughts?

kevin: i'm leaning to pinning canary -> 2026.02.4 for tonight to keep the window, and fully re-run the release pipeline tomorrow with artifact validation. less blast radius.

ana: quick mitigation: we can checksum-verify objects before promote and fail fast. but fix in CI needed to prevent multipart race.

ci-bot: CI job #4621 (build-serve) failed artifact verification: uploaded digest mismatch. logs: https://ci.internal/4621/logs

maria: agreed with kevin. can we do a manual pin and then schedule a rebuild? who can do the pin/update deploybot config?

kevin: i'll update the canary route to 2026.02.4 and push a temporary route-lock tag. doing it now.

deploy-bot: route update: staging-canary -> redwood/serve:2026.02.4 by kevin at 2460123472 :white_check_mark:

jen: i'll open a release-blocking issue and add steps for a clean rebuild + verification + postmortem. adding owners: @ana, @kevin, @maria, @oncall-sre.

ana: will investigate the multipart upload retry logic and add a checksum-finalize step in the CI uploader. Expect a PR today.

oncall-sre: oncall will watch staging for any fallout from the route change. if anything odd, ping me.

maria: for release notes: note that 2026.03.1 was held due to artifact integrity issue, canary pinned to 2026.02.4, next attempt after rebuild + verification. I'll draft a short note for customers and internal release channel.

kevin: also recommend adding a pre-promote verification in deploy-bot: fetch artifact, verify sha256, then promote. less manual ops.

deploy-bot: feature request recorded: pre-promote artifact verification + abort on mismatch (ticket RB-1142).

jen: OK. Action items: kevin pinned canary -> done; ana investigating CI uploader + will PR checksum fix; maria drafting release note; jen opens incident-style issue for postmortem. re-evaluate tomorrow morning.

maria: thanks. if we have a clean rebuild and CI upload verified, can we do a manual promote outside the automated canary window? i'd rather avoid immediate auto-promote to prod.

kevin: yes, manual promote only. we'll add an explicit opt-in step after verification.

ana: PR opened: https://git.internal/r/uploader/pulls/89 - adds finalize+sha check to multipart upload. cc @jen

ci-bot: rebuild queued: build-serve #4622 (fresh artifacts)

maria: i'll monitor #builds and confirm artifact sha once job completes. thanks all. :pray:
